command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'flyexplorer_large_icons_benchmark.py'; @'

import base64, io, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
import psutil

root = Path(os.environ["TEMP"]) / "flyExplorer-large-icons-benchmark-owned"
if root.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(root)
root.mkdir(parents=True)
for i in range(1, 13):
    (root / f"Benchmark item {i:02d}.txt").write_text(f"owned benchmark {i}\n", encoding="utf-8")
for i in range(1, 5):
    img = Image.new("RGB", (320, 200), (40*i, 36*i, 28*i))
    img.save(root / f"Sample image {i:02d}.png")
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe", "/separate,", str(root)])
deadline = time.time() + 15
window = None
while time.time() < deadline:
    for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
        try:
            title = w.window_text()
            pid = w.element_info.process_id
            name = psutil.Process(pid).name().lower()
            if root.name.lower() in title.lower() and name == "explorer.exe":
                window = w
                break
        except Exception:
            pass
    if window:
        break
    time.sleep(0.3)
if not window:
    raise RuntimeError("owned Explorer benchmark window not found")
window.set_focus()
try:
    window.move_window(x=40, y=40, width=972, height=720, repaint=True)
except Exception:
    pass
time.sleep(0.8)
send_keys("^+2")
time.sleep(1.2)
items = []
for control in window.descendants(control_type="ListItem")[:12]:
    try:
        r = control.rectangle()
        text = control.window_text()
        if text:
            items.append((text, r.left, r.top, r.width(), r.height()))
    except Exception:
        pass
print("EXPLORER_LARGE_ITEM_COUNT", len(items))
for row in items[:8]:
    print("EXPLORER_LARGE_ITEM_RECT", repr(row))
img = window.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
img.thumbnail((486, 360))
buf = io.BytesIO()
img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=78, optimize=True)
print("EXPLORER_LARGE_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN")
print(base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii"))
print("EXPLORER_LARGE_SCREENSHOT_END")
try:
    window.close()
except Exception:
    pass

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($rc -ne 0){exit $rc}
